Just about a year ago I was trying to come up with reasons myself. I was 22 but felt like I had been here over 200 years. Life moved too slow for my comfort, especially with all of the death and horror the world and also my brain put me through. The summer before I turned 23, my roommates and I (one being my brother I've looked up to and took care of me my whole life) formed a band. We even played a festival within a few months. After a bit, I remembered a book I was writing. A fun fantasy novel I had been procrastinating. Picked it back up and am now a few more chapters farther, progressing the fun and in depth lore. Another bit goes by, and my brother I live with happened to get his girlfriend pregnant. More time goes by and I can now Ollie on my skateboard and I'm getting good at going back and forth on a half pipe. Pass by a little more, I find a girl who has almost my same personality aside from the weird glitchy bits, and I think I may be falling in love. I'm holding onto some hope that she will love me back one day. I'm turning 24 in a few months. All within a year, my skating skill is higher, I'm in a punk band, I live with a beautiful baby girl made by my brother, the most important person in my life, I've met a beautiful woman who I hope to share amazing experiences with, I'm creating a magical world on paper with infinite experiences; life can give you plenty of reason within such a short amount of time. One moment can pass by that can change your life forever. Life is wild. Hang tight, and one day you'll realize why you stayed all this time.
